claim: For the real two-dimensional Cesàro space \(\mathrm{ces}_2^{(2)}\), with \(\|(x,y)\|=\bigl(|x|^2+((|x|+|y|)/2)^2\bigr)^{1/2}\), the Banach--Mazur distance to the Euclidean plane is exactly \(d_{\mathrm{BM}}(\mathrm{ces}_2^{(2)},\ell_2^2)=\sqrt{1+1/\sqrt5}\).
integrity: The distance is proved by matching upper and lower ellipsoid-containment bounds. The literature comparison distinguishes inspected full-text implications from the limited evidentiary force of unsuccessful searches.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to the real two-dimensional p=2 Cesàro section. The proof is complete, while the originality assessment remains subject to the usual risk of older results stated under different notation or equivalent convex-body language.
title: Exact Euclidean Banach--Mazur distance of the two-dimensional Cesàro space
